doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: Jimmy Noon, Nene Quacku and the barbers
title: Nene Quacku, the cornetist, and his clarinetist brother
summary: Tom and Martin recall Nene Quacku, a good cornet player from the Violet side who later went to California. His crippled brother played clarinet and Tom played with him. The men mention Phil Waco and Louis Lillet.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals
